findings.reason: §9 must state the actual route (have the MDSplus branch build a `DataAccess` and call `persist_data_access` directly, or give it a scanner that returns a `ScanResult`), otherwise its stated mechanism does not reach the branch it claims to unify.
findings.text: §9(b) makes `persist_data_access(data_access)` the single DataAccess writer and says the MDSplus branch "stops constructing its node inline and populates `ScanResult.data_access` like every other scanner", but the MDSplus path is a bespoke branch (tested at parallel.py:2406 `if scanner_type == "mdsplus":`) that never calls `scanner.scan()` and never builds a `ScanResult`; it constructs the node inline at 2483-2506 and `continue`s at 2518, so there is no `ScanResult` to populate and the new writer is unreachable there — the duplicate survives and the §9 done-when (rg finds exactly one `MERGE (…:DataAccess` inside `persist_data_access`) cannot be met.

findings.reason: the section enumerates "the signal and wiki-chunk indexes" as the remaining starvation sites; this index is a fourth, in the very call path §12 fixes, so the annotation list must include it (or say why it is out of scope).
findings.text: §12 rebuilds only the `code_chunk_embedding` index and §16 lists only the signal and wiki-chunk indexes, but `_search_code` also calls `_vector_search_code_examples`, which post-filters `ce.facility_id = $facility` after the ANN cut on a third index (`code_example_desc_embedding`) and hides every failure behind a bare `except Exception: return []` at 1593, so a small facility's code examples stay silently starved after this plan lands.

findings.reason: repairing in place matches the pattern §3 already landed and is the smaller change; extracting a helper is separate cleanup, not a defect this plan introduces.
findings.text: §13 repairs the wiki-chunk fulltext query-parameter collision and the over-broad `except` in place, a third copy of the repair §3 already landed in `_text_search_signals` (search_tools.py:514) and `_text_search_code_chunks` (search_tools.py:1663), with no shared helper extracted and a fourth site possible.

findings.reason: the three call sites and the one-probe-per-invocation invariant are correct; only the helper's name in the brief is wrong, a one-word correction.
findings.text: §9(a) cites its third `probe_remote_environment` caller as `require_remote_environment` in `imas_codex/cli/discover/common.py`, but no such symbol exists; the function is `ensure_remote_environment` (common.py:441, called from discover/signals.py:163 and discover/code.py:185).

duplicate_owner-3.reason: repairing the wiki-chunk collision in place matches the pattern §3 landed in the signal and code-chunk searches and is the smaller change; extracting a shared fulltext helper is separate cleanup that this plan did not introduce

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no section adds a parallel subsystem; §12/§15 route all index DDL through the existing owner and §15 explicitly removes wrappers rather than adding them.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: two findings — §9(b)'s consolidated writer is unreachable from the MDSplus branch, and §12/§16 leave a third starved index in the same `_search_code` call path.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; no section adds to any counted family. §12's added schema surface (the `vector_index_filters` property and its sibling generated map) is named in-text together with what it retires (the `cc.facility_id = $facility` where-clauses entry in `_search_code`), §16 states nothing is added because the annotation key already exists and the over-fetch constant is retired, and §9's added `environment=` parameter is an internal function argument that retires `get_python_status`'s second probe.

One minor citation error only (see reuse_search finding).
